name: Session purge
summary: permanently remove an asleep session and everything traced to it: its record, database rows, search and archive entries, Claude Code and Codex transcripts, todos, file history, behind Beast Mode plus typing the session's name.
how_to: Arm Beast Mode first; a purge is refused while it is off.
Plan the purge: POST the route with apply false and read what it would remove.
To apply, POST it with apply true, the plan's plan_fingerprint and confirm_text set to the session's exact name.
The receipt of what was removed lands in purge-receipts in the app's state folder.
examples: A throwaway session full of pasted secrets: purge it so its transcript, archive copy and search entries are gone, not just hidden from the list.
media_exempt: an owner API route only; there is no screen for it
